articles.title: Resetting your password
articles.body:
# Forgot your password?

On the sign-in page choose "Forgot password" and enter your account email. We send a reset link that is valid for 60 minutes.

If the email doesn't arrive within 10 minutes, check your spam folder or ask us to resend it.

articles.title: Refund policy
articles.body:
# Refunds

You can request a refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds go back to the original payment method and take 5 to 10 business days to appear.

Gift cards and shipping fees are not refundable.

articles.title: Shipping times and costs
articles.body:
# Shipping

Orders ship within 2 business days. Standard delivery in the EU takes 3 to 5 business days and costs 4.90 EUR; it is free above 50 EUR.

Express delivery (1 to 2 days) costs 12 EUR.

articles.title: Returning an item
articles.body:
# Returns

To return an item, open your order and click "Start a return". Print the prepaid label and drop the parcel at any post office within 14 days.

Items must be unused and in their original packaging.

articles.title: Two-factor authentication
articles.body:
# Two-factor authentication (2FA)

Turn on 2FA under Settings > Security. You can use any authenticator app. Save your 10 backup codes somewhere safe: each code works once if you lose your phone.

articles.title: Downloading invoices and VAT
articles.body:
# Invoices

Invoices are in Account > Orders > Invoice (PDF). Prices include VAT at your country's rate. Business customers can add a VAT ID at checkout to get a reverse-charge invoice.
